en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town by a lake or river. In the foreground are reeds and grassy banks; across the water stands a cluster of low houses and farm buildings, with a church steeple rising above trees on a hill to the right. The sky is filled with scattered clouds. The caption "Talsi." appears in the lower left corner and "Talsen." in the lower center; in the lower right corner there is a small imprint resembling a publisher mark or logo.
